newsitem.title: SPAIN: Clashes erupt over killing of Basque politician.
newsitem.headline: Clashes erupt over killing of Basque politician.

text.p: Peaceful protests against the killing of a young politician by Basque separatists turned violent in some areas on Monday when supporters and opponents of the guerrilla group ETA clashed, injuring at least two people.

In the Basque towns of Bilbao and San Sebastian, pitched battles broke out when demonstrators threw eggs and rocks at offices and bars used by ETA's political wing Herri Batasuna (HB). ETA sympathisers retaliated with Molotov cocktails.
Basque police calmed the situation in San Sebastian, but violent clashes continued in Bilbao late into the night.

The killing of Miguel Angel Blanco at the weekend has sparked a national outcry with millions of Spaniards taking to the streets to condemn the Basque separatist group and mourn the death of the town councillor.
Almost all the gatherings were peaceful. In Madrid, more than a million people attended a demonstration led by Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar on Monday night.

Blanco, 29, was killed after ETA rebels kidnapped him and demanded the government move hundreds of ETA prisoners to the Basque region before 4 p.m on Saturday. He was found bound and bleeding on a mountain roadside just outside San Sebastian shortly after the deadline and died nearly 12 hours later.
